objectives.description: Drive JSON payloads through the tracked source hook (never the live .claude/hooks/ copy)
Existing destructive detectors still behave (reset --hard, stash pop, restore --staged)
Marker independence: fresh marker does not exempt git add -A, still exempts git reset --hard
Confirm edits tracked (no .claude/ path) and deliverable-rule sweep over touched files

deviations.description: Take a fresh snapshot marker before the marker-independence check
deviations.reason: Invoking the real scripts/git-snapshot.sh would perform a real git stash or scratch-branch WIP commit against the shared working tree, which currently has concurrent-session uncommitted changes (task 882 running in parallel, per this plan's own Territory note). Constructed the marker file directly instead (same TIMESTAMP=<epoch> contract the hook consumes), exercising the identical code path without touching the shared tree.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered — marker constructed directly instead of via git-snapshot.sh, to avoid disturbing the concurrent task's uncommitted changes)*

deviations.description: Confirm edits are tracked via git status --short
deviations.reason: Per the mandatory commit-per-green-substep rule, Phase 1 and Phase 2 edits were already committed by the time Phase 3 ran, so git status --short no longer shows them as modified. Verified via git show --stat on the two phase commits instead, confirming no .claude/ path in either.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered — verified via git show --stat on phase commits instead of git status --short)*
